title: Coordination fabric and engagement tooling
story: As the engagement lead I need the board, hubs, sprint, spend, scorecard, RTM, claims-merge and contract-validation tooling so nine teams can work in parallel with an audit trail
acceptance: Fabric tooling ported from the reference program runs: node org/cli.mjs tickets lists tickets
node org/rtm.mjs writes brief/requirements.md with coverage computed from done tickets
node org/claims.mjs merges research/claims/*.json and rejects duplicate ids
node org/contracts/validate.mjs validates shards and contract files and flags citations to unknown or unverified claims

verdicts.reason: All 5 criteria met: 6/6 tests pass; tickets/rtm/claims/validate run; dup-id rejection and unknown/unverified citation flagging proven in sandbox; nits only (no tests for claims/fabric, sparse CLI usage text)
